note: Sixty sentences of the slice, labelled by hand: 40 duties and 20 non-duties. A sentence is a duty when it obliges its addressee to report or notify, prove, inform or give information, document or keep records, evaluate a law's effects, or check; an authority's duty stated in the present tense counts. Substantive duties (pay, hand over, design, insure), permissions, definitions, scope and form rules are not duties here. The labels await confirmation.
method: Sentences of data/corpus were ordered within each family of config/slice.json by SHA-256 of "2026|<paragraph id>|<sentence text>", the families interleaved in slice order, and every sentence was labelled in that order until 40 duties and 20 non-duties were found; later non-duties were skipped. The sample index records each sentence's place in that order.
